posts.name: Product Hunt Visual Launch Editor
posts.tagline: See your launch as you build it
posts.description: See your Product Hunt launch come to life as you build it! The new visual editor lets you edit your launch in fewer steps while while automatically saving your draft. You can simply click the name, tagline, gallery or makers to edit them in place. A checklist shows what's required and what will help your launch stand out, and clicking a checklist item will take you straight to the field that needs work. Drafts, scheduled launches and live launches now all use the same editor.

posts.name: MOVO AI
posts.tagline: The world's first long-form video agent for mobile
posts.description: MOVO AI is the world’s first AI video agent for long-form creation that works right from your phone. It also works on the web. Shoot, upload, or start with an idea, then tell MOVO AI what you want. MOVO plans, creates, refines, keeps characters and scenes consistent, and brings the whole video together. Lock your phone and MOVO keeps working. Come back to review or make changes through chat. No prompt gymnastics. No canvas-heavy workflows. No manual clip stitching.

posts.name: Agent Hunt
posts.tagline: Live rankings of the tools AI agents use most
posts.description: Agent Hunt is a live leaderboard of the tools AI agents actually use. Every place is earned by real calls agents make through Monid.

posts.name: Ovren Live Preview
posts.tagline: See your product change live before it ships
posts.description: Describe a change in plain words. Ovren writes the code on a safe copy of your project and gives you a live preview of every frontend change — your real page, with the change on it. Click through it, approve it, and your team merges the pull request.

posts.name: ElevenLabs Realtime
posts.tagline: Realtime voice agent models with 570ms to first audio
posts.description: Eleven Realtime is ElevenLabs’ new family of speech-to-speech models for voice agents. Speech recognition, turn-taking, the LLM and the voice are tuned end-to-end. v1 Mini is built for natural conversation, v1 Max for complex tasks, with 620ms and 570ms to first audio. It supports 90+ languages and works in ElevenAgents or through an OpenAI-compatible Realtime API, so you only change the endpoint and model name.

posts.name: ShogunAI
posts.tagline: Your personal AGI on your pc
posts.description: An AI assistant that remembers your work and helps with meeting prep, search, writing and follow-ups. Try ShogunAI for Mac free for 7 days.

posts.name: FLUX 3 Max
posts.tagline: fal’s FLUX 3 Max: 10-second AI video in about 12 seconds
posts.description: FLUX 3 Max is fal’s post-trained text-to-video and image-to-video model, built with Black Forest Labs on the FLUX 3 base. fal says it generates a 10-second 720p clip in about 12 seconds, around 10x faster than FLUX 3. It is tied for #1 on a preliminary Artificial Analysis image-to-video board. Pricing is $0.0425 per second of video through November 7 (list $0.17), with a playground and API.

posts.name: Cloudflare Clairic
posts.tagline: Cloudflare's AI model for fast, cheap data extraction
posts.description: Clairic is Cloudflare's new AI model for extracting structured information without generating tokens. Give it messy text or images, and it returns typed values like names, dates, amounts, calculations, and estimates in a single pass, with confidence scores. Built for developers who need faster, cheaper data processing than traditional LLM calls. Available in preview on Workers AI at $0.10 per million input tokens, with open weights planned.

posts.name: Context Engine
posts.tagline: One memory for your AI agents and human team members.
posts.description: Context Engine is one memory for your AI agents and your team. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code save to it as they work, and the people on your team read it, ask it questions and add files. Free to start.

posts.name: Polylane for Cloudflare
posts.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Cloudflare apps
posts.description: Polylane catches issues across your Cloudflare apps, follows the connections between Workers, databases, queues and storage, and investigates the root cause using your code, logs and recent changes. When the fix is in your code, it opens a pull request for review. Connect with one read-only Cloudflare token.

posts.name: Dub Startup Program
posts.tagline: Launch your partner-led growth program
posts.description: Launch your partner program, track every referral, and reward the people helping you grow. Get 50% off your first year of Dub.

posts.name: Instant Search
posts.tagline: The fastest, most precise local AI Search for your files.
posts.description: Instant is the first accurate local AI file search that uses the latest embedding models to find the exact file (and page) with the content you’re looking for with a 95% hit rate.

posts.name: Monish
posts.tagline: Your AI agents, live on your iPhone lock screen
posts.description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, n8n or any script. Your agent can then put live progress on your lock screen, ping you when it's done, and ask before it deploys, sends or spends: Approve or Deny from the notification. Free, no account.

posts.name: Inyon
posts.tagline: Answer your coding agents from your phone
posts.description: Inyon shows the coding agents already running in tmux on your machines (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Antigravity) as chats on your phone or in a browser. When one asks something, you answer with a tap and it's typed into the same pane, so nothing changes when you sit back down. No account and nothing to host: pair the Android app by QR code and it reaches your computers over an end-to-end encrypted tunnel or your VPN. Free, open source, MIT.

posts.name: Plango
posts.tagline: Use AI to defend against AI
posts.description: Secure your Mac while building with AI. Plango monitors AI coding agents, protects sensitive files and secrets, blocks suspicious network activity, scans projects for vulnerabilities, and gives you control over what your agents can access. Powered by an on-device AI security model. Private by default.

posts.name: Headroom
posts.tagline: Your Mac on iPhone Duo: fold it, and the keyboard appears
posts.description: Control your Mac from iPhone, iPad or another Mac. Headroom is a Screen Sharing client: remote access with nothing to install on the Mac, no account, no server in between. On iPhone Duo it changes with every pose: half open, Mac on top, keyboard below.

posts.name: Peras
posts.tagline: Pause Claude Code and Codex before they burn your week
posts.description: Peras puts a line in your Claude Code and Codex week. Set it (peras set weekly 85 pause) and once usage crosses it, the agent's next tool call is refused with a plain reason, so one long task can't burn the rest of your week. Resume whenever you want, from the terminal or the menu bar. Opt-in: your agents can be told their own usage. The CLI and hooks are free and MIT. The native Mac menu bar app is €4.99 once.

posts.name: Dots
posts.tagline: A customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch
posts.description: Meet Dots, a customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch. Most notch apps focus on music and notifications. Dots goes further by helping you access your favorite apps, websites, and shortcuts without constantly switching windows. Watch videos while working, take scrolling screenshots, use voice commands, and more. Whether you're studying, coding, or creating, Dots adapts to your workflow. Free to get started. No subscriptions.

posts.name: Truffle
posts.tagline: Fix messy tags, covers and duplicates in your Mac library
posts.description: Truffle recognizes each track by its sound and checks eight sources to fix titles, artists, albums, genres, covers, tempo and key. Works with Apple Music, local folders, rekordbox, Serato and Traktor. Nothing is written until you confirm.

posts.name: Termi Protocol
posts.tagline: Watch AI agents code in 3D and hand off the work
posts.description: Termi is a 3D room where your real coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and more) work at their own desks. You watch every file read, command and edit live, not a scrolling log. New since our first launch: when an agent hits a usage, rate or context limit, Termi saves its goal, changed files, errors and todos, then hands the work to an agent on another model. A boss agent splits one goal across your team. Deleted agents go to a trash. Now on macOS, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: DotMD
posts.tagline: Review your AI agent's Markdown specs like a pull request
posts.description: Your AI agents write the specs, plans and docs. DotMD is a native Mac Markdown app where you review them like a pull request: comment on exact lines, the agent fixes them over MCP, and you accept every change. Also a fast reader and editor: Mermaid, math, code, version history, search, PDF export. Everything stays on your Mac. Free to read.

posts.name: Dots Phone
posts.tagline: A phone-calling plugin for OpenAI Dots
posts.description: Dots Phone is an independent plugin for OpenAI Dots. Give Dots a phone task: it prepares a brief, makes the call, asks Codex for missing details when needed, and reports the result. Self-hosted with your OpenAI and Twilio accounts.

posts.name: Bloblings
posts.tagline: A pet for every Claude Code session
posts.description: Every Claude Code and Codex thread gets a pet that acts out its work and shows when it needs you. One click opens the thread. Threads pass notes and work as a team, and you see every one. Free, native, and nothing leaves your Mac.

posts.name: Gerty
posts.tagline: Private ChatGPT alternative that sets itself up on your Mac
posts.description: Gerty is a private AI assistant that runs entirely on your Mac. It measures your Mac, picks the best open models for each job (chat, writing, code, understanding and making pictures), downloads them and sets them up as one assistant. No terminal, no setup. It works with your documents, mail and calendar, you can ask it out loud, and it shows you every change before it makes it. No account, no cloud, works offline. CHF 49 once for 3 Macs, 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Otter Hire
posts.tagline: Modern AI ATS to Recruit & Hire - Unlimited Everything
posts.description: Otter is a modern, AI-powered ATS that makes recruiting calm, fast, and simple. Manage jobs, candidates, applications, interviews, and scorecards in one place. Turn emailed resumes into candidate profiles with AI resume parsing, build your careers page, track your hiring pipeline, and get actionable reports. Integrate with your workflows using our API and MCP server. One flat price per workspace, with unlimited users and candidates. Start your 14-day free trial - no credit card required.

posts.name: Vassant: Investment Strategy
posts.tagline: Research, Organize & Allocate
posts.description: Vassant is THE decision-making hub for self-directed investors with 3 core features: 1. Investment Organization: Seamlessly manage all portfolios, plan investments, document theses, and track allocations. 2. Capital Modeling: Optimize investable cash and distribute money across accounts. 3. Discovery: Read free articles, master investment concepts, and unveil thorough deep dives. We hold no funds, execute no trades, and earn nothing when you trade more. We build for the long-term investor.

posts.name: IconOven
posts.tagline: Every icon your app needs: app icons and 85,000+ UI icons
posts.description: IconOven is a small icon studio. Our app icons are ready kits for Xcode, Android Studio and the web: light, dark and tinted, every size, a plain licence. Standard is $100, Exclusive $249. Our 85,000+ UI icons come in 13 styles: Stroke is free under MIT, Pro and Max unlock them all, from $59 a year. Install from npm, Swift, Flutter, Android, VS Code or Figma. Free tools too: App Icon Exporter and App Icon Score.

posts.name: Avatar SDK Move | Lifelike AI Motion
posts.tagline: Turn text into hyper-realistic motion for human avatars
posts.description: We all know what it means to “move like an NPC”: stiff gestures and robotic motion. Avatar SDK Move makes your avatars move like real people. Just describe an action in plain text and generate realistic animations with natural, expressive movement—no motion capture equipment required. Export animations in MetaPerson skeleton format or for Unity’s Humanoid rig via our Unity Move plugin. More export options coming soon.

posts.name: GifBook Studio
posts.tagline: Draw it. Flip it. Print it.
posts.description: GifBook Studio turns your iPhone into a hand-drawn animation studio. Sketch a character, add frames, tap play — and watch your drawing move. Share it as a GIF, or print a flipbook you can hold. Four animated starters (including Poe's Perfect Hat), three layers, onion skin, per-frame timing, and GIF import up to 120 frames. $4.99 once — no subscription, no ads, no account. Made for iPhone Duo, great on any iPhone. In beta on TestFlight now — join the waitlist for launch day, October 23.

posts.name: 25launches
posts.tagline: Linktree for your launches.
posts.description: One page that tells your maker story: every product you’ve launched on a board of 25, what you’re building this week, a backlog your followers vote on, and an honest graveyard for the ones that died. Free for makers.

posts.name: AniDachi
posts.tagline: Crunchyroll, YouTube & Netflix watch parties with friends
posts.description: AniDachi is a Chrome extension to watch anime and shows with friends on Crunchyroll, YouTube and Netflix. Playback stays synced, with chat, reactions and voice/video calls right on the video -- no screen sharing. Friends join free.

posts.name: Trezio
posts.tagline: Save anything. Find it by what you remember.
posts.description: Trezio is your internet memory: one place for links, notes, screenshots, and voice memos. Capture from Chrome, web, or Android, organize with folders and tags, and find what you need later with search that understands meaning, not just exact words.

posts.name: Nanotype
posts.tagline: A private online text editor with markdown. Open and type.
posts.description: Nanotype is a free, minimal, fast, private in-browser text editor with Markdown. The text is stored only in your browser, never on a server. Works offline, customizable editor, focus mode, slash commands, sharing with no server in between. Just open and use.

posts.name: ElderMate
posts.tagline: AI check-in calls for parents. A short summary for you.
posts.description: Your parents' morning might be your midnight. Flights, work trips or night shifts can interrupt your usual call. ElderMate makes scheduled AI check-in calls and gives you a short summary afterward. Add your own call notes, such as asking whether a parent has taken their usual medication. They simply answer their phone—no app needed. Available on iOS and Android, with 5 free calling minutes to start.

posts.name: Clutch Ledger
posts.tagline: One number for every NBA game, graded in public
posts.description: Clutch puts a win probability on every NBA game, tells you why, and seals it before tip. After the final, every call is graded in a public Ledger, misses included. Then it's your turn: make your own call and try to beat Clutch, change who plays with What-If and watch the number move, or Ask Clutch anything about tonight. Free in the browser and on iPhone.

posts.name: Rheo
posts.tagline: Analytics, experiments and messaging in one platform
posts.description: Rheo puts product analytics, onboarding and paywalls, lifecycle messaging, and customer profiles behind a single SDK for mobile and web apps.

posts.name: Ember: Markdown Notes
posts.tagline: Capture, write, and connect ideas with Markdown.
posts.description: Ember is a native Markdown notes app for iPhone and iPad. Write in a live editor with tables, checklists, code, math, and Mermaid diagrams. Type a hex code like #E8743B and it appears in that color. Connect ideas with @ mentions, nested #tags, and Daily Notes, and search text inside PDFs and images. Prompt Vault saves your AI prompts with {{variables}} you fill in before copying. Unlimited standard notes and iCloud sync are completely free. The Mac app is in TestFlight.

posts.name: My Startup Story
posts.tagline: A 100% free startup simulator that's brutally hard
posts.description: Build a startup and try to keep it alive. Hire a team, ship products, manage cash, pay taxes and weigh funding against equity. A brutally hard business simulator for iOS, in English and Spanish. 100% free. No subscriptions or in-app purchases.

posts.name: CoreMVP
posts.tagline: Everything you need to build your product. Launch in days.
posts.description: The premium Next.js template with everything you need to get your product in front of customers: auth, Stripe billing, teams, file uploads, SEO, docs, agent workflows and end-to-end tests, already connected. Your idea, launched in days.

posts.name: Amoenia
posts.tagline: Know if your retreat makes money before you book
posts.description: Planning software for independent retreat organizers. Enter your costs, see how many guests you need and what to charge, then track bookings, deposits and payments as they arrive. Free for your first retreat. In English, French, Spanish and German.

posts.name: Amoenia
posts.tagline: Know if your retreat makes money before you book
posts.description: Planning software for independent retreat organizers. Enter your costs, see how many guests you need and what to charge, then track bookings, deposits and payments as they arrive. Free for your first retreat. In English, French, Spanish and German.

posts.name: Keyly
posts.tagline: See every shortcut in any Mac app with a double-tap
posts.description: Keyly is a free, open-source menu bar app for macOS. Double-tap ⇪ Caps Lock, or any key you choose, to see every shortcut of the app you're in, read live from its menus. Search them, add your own in plain text, or install one of 31 templates.

posts.name: DataFeeds by Rolling Insights
posts.tagline: Agent-ready live sports data: REST, MCP
posts.description: DataFeeds | Real Time Sports Data API Powering Websites, Draft Kits, Fantasy SportsLive and historical sports data for builders who ship AI-first products. Connect via REST, or MCP plus Sports AI Skills so coding agents can query NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA, soccer, PGA, and darts without wrestling docs. 30-day free trial. No contracts. & Media Platforms

posts.name: Figma code layers
posts.tagline: Design, code and specs together on one Figma canvas
posts.description: Figma’s code layers put working code on the design canvas, next to the designs. Create one from a frame, a GitHub repo, a webpage via Chrome extension, or by asking the Figma agent. Compare options side by side, and turn a code layer’s states back into editable layers. Figma Specs add design and technical requirements on the canvas, and Payload connects data to Make. Public beta.

posts.name: ByteSend
posts.tagline: Send and receive email. Open source, pay as you go
posts.description: ByteSend is an open-source email platform. Send transactional and marketing email by API, SMTP or SDK, and now receive it too, with webhooks, an inbox and forwarding. DMARC reports, test mode and 5,000 free emails a month. Self-host or use our cloud.

posts.name: HUNTA - Treasure Hunts
posts.tagline: Self-guided treasure hunts created by locals
posts.description: HUNTA turns any town into a treasure hunt. Locals build self-guided hunts from the secrets they already know... free to create, in an afternoon, no coding. They earn 60% of every sale, forever. Players get a real-world adventure: follow clues, find hidden corners, learn what guidebooks never tell you. 25 hunts live across the UK, Italy, France, Greece, Thailand and New Zealand... every new town comes from a creator who lives there. Build one for your town, or play one this weekend.

posts.name: Traveler Map
posts.tagline: Discover the world's natural and cultural wonders
posts.description: Traveler Map helps you discover natural wonders and cultural heritage sites around the world through interactive maps. Explore inspiring destinations, find ideas for your next adventure, and build an itinerary around the places you want to visit. Whether you're planning a vacation or simply exploring the world from home, your journey starts at Travelermap.net.

posts.name: Online Video Editor
posts.tagline: Batch video editor tools that run locally in your browser
posts.description: Trim, crop, compress, mute and watermark videos in your browser. Combine editing steps and batch-process files. Editing and export run on your device, without uploading local videos. Free to use, with no account required.

posts.name: Copybook
posts.tagline: You copied it. Then you copied something else. Copybook it!
posts.description: Copybook is a menu-bar clipboard book for your Mac. Each day gets its own page so copies don’t fall into one endless pile. Notes, titled links, pictures, and named colors land as stickers; API keys and tokens stay covered until you reveal them. One payment (£4.99 / $4.99), no account, and no cloud sync.

posts.name: Doc Diff
posts.tagline: Compare PDF, Word and text files without uploading them
posts.description: Compare PDF, DOCX and pasted text side by side, even across formats. Highlight changes, edit the revised text and export the result. Runs in your browser without uploading your documents. Free, open source, and available as an offline HTML file.

posts.name: rwaft
posts.tagline: Personalised Website Builder
posts.description: Describe an app in plain words. rwaft's AI writes it, builds it and hosts it at its own URL while you watch the real build. Or deploy a public React repo.

posts.name: There Is No Floor
posts.tagline: A windmill puzzle adventure above the clouds
posts.description: Tap, time, and soar between spinning windmills above the clouds. Plan your route, collect golden sails, and chase three stars across 60 handcrafted levels in four floating worlds. Discover crumbling and vanishing windmills, ordered beacons, and heroes with unique powers, then keep exploring with generated expeditions.

posts.name: Storage Menu
posts.tagline: Disk space in your Mac menu bar, and what's using it
posts.description: Storage Menu shows used and free space for your Mac and external drives right in the menu bar, with a warning you set for each volume. Choose Analyze… on any volume to open a disk map: every folder is a cell sized by the space it takes, colored by folder, file type or age. Click to go inside, preview with Quick Look or show in Finder. Nothing is changed or deleted. No telemetry, no data collected. Native Swift app for macOS 14+, Apple Silicon and Intel, in 50 languages.

posts.name: Orisuji
posts.tagline: A paper maze you solve by folding your iPhone Duo
posts.description: Orisuji is a turn-based maze puzzle designed for iPhone Duo. Unfolded, the phone is a book: a paper maze on the right page, a second sheet with holes on the left. Fold it and the two pages become one maze on the cover screen. Unfold it and the left page lifts away, carrying whoever stood on it. 69 levels in six worlds, with a red crane, two cats, a fox and a gold-leaf moon. It plays on every iPhone and iPad too. $4.99, no ads, no in-app purchases.

posts.name: Reva
posts.tagline: Everything you own, on one screen
posts.description: Reva puts your bank accounts, mutual funds, shares, FDs, RSUs and property into one net worth, for you and your partner. Upload a mutual fund or bank statement and Reva reads it in your browser, so the file never leaves your device. It checks every figure against the statement before saving, and shows a dash where a number is missing instead of guessing. Reva is read-only, sells no products and gives analysis, not advice. Built for Indian households.

posts.name: NoShorts
posts.tagline: Block YouTube Shorts and set a daily watch-time limit
posts.description: NoShorts is two free, open-source userscripts for people who want YouTube, just less of it. One removes Shorts completely. The other sets a daily video limit, shows a timer and private viewing history, and stops playback when time is up. Once you've started watching, changing the limit only takes effect tomorrow (no "just 10 more minutes" loophole lol). Made for iPhone Safari via Userscripts and compatible desktop browsers. No account, subscription, or backend.

posts.name: RGE Launch
posts.tagline: Rendered by Reality™
posts.description: Powered by the Reality Graphics Engine, these frames are ready for sunglasses or prescription eyeware. Lux is the first offering in this engaging product line called Renderism™.

posts.name: OptionStack
posts.tagline: Options trading tools compared, with dated prices
posts.description: An independent index of 76 options trading tools: flow, GEX, visualizers, journals, data APIs and more. Every price comes from the vendor's own pricing page with the date checked. No brokers, no trade alerts, no ratings. Free, no signup.

posts.name: OkaPace: Payday and Budget Planner
posts.tagline: Know what you can spend
posts.description: Track expenses, plan bills, manage budgets, and see how much you can safely spend each day with OkaPace, your simple personal finance app.

posts.name: Spotnxt
posts.tagline: Agent for Performance Marketing
posts.description: Run Meta & Google Ads with AI, build automated distribution funnels, and auto-sync leads into a sales pipeline. Automate your entire ad-to-revenue journey.

posts.name: OkaPace: Payday and Budget Planner
posts.tagline: Know what you can spend
posts.description: Track expenses, plan bills, manage budgets, and see how much you can safely spend each day with OkaPace, your simple personal finance app.

posts.name: Tripeaz
posts.tagline: Plan trips together, on iPhone or from your AI app
posts.description: Tripeaz turns group chat chaos into one shared itinerary. Your group suggests places, votes, and adds the winner to the day. Every stop stays on a map, in order, on everyone's phone. New in this launch: • The iPhone app, free on the App Store • Tripeaz MCP: plan from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP app. Ask what's still unplanned, or have it fill in the days. Version History can undo any change. • A new look, from the logo up

posts.name: WABB
posts.tagline: AI-powered sales and support automation for WhatsApp
posts.description: AI-powered WhatsApp automation platform for sales, marketing, and support with no-code workflows. WABB isn’t just a chatbot tool — it’s your AI-powered sales engine for WhatsApp that turns every customer touchpoint into revenue on autopilot.

posts.name: Royaltify Studio | Music Distribution
posts.tagline: Free Music Distribution Service for Indian artists & Labels
posts.description: Releasing music from India shouldn't be complicated by international tax withholding and expensive foreign currency subscription fees. Royaltify Studio (studio.royaltify.in) is built from the ground up for Indian creators. Upload unlimited songs, assign collaborator split-sheets, get free ISRC and UPC barcodes, and reach 150+ global platforms including JioSaavn, Wynk, Spotify, Apple Music, and Instagram Reels in 24–48 hours with direct INR bank & UPI payouts.

posts.name: Stuon World
posts.tagline: A multiplayer world for studying together
posts.description: Stuon World turns studying into a shared multiplayer experience. Create your pixel character, explore a virtual library, meet other students, join study groups, focus together, earn coins, and customize your character as you study.

posts.name: Yaha
posts.tagline: Sell anything. Anywhere. Anytime.
posts.description: Create your shop, share one link, get paid. Whatever you make, cook, host, or care about, Yaha is where people buy it.

posts.name: Market Data Singapore
posts.tagline: Free Singapore Market Intelligence, S-REITs & Financial Data
posts.description: Market Data Singapore is a financial intelligence and data platform dedicated to Singapore’s financial markets, real estate investment trusts, economic indicators, property analytics, and statutory financial calculations. The platform brings together research reports, interactive calculators, downloadable datasets, and market information to help users explore Singapore’s economic and financial landscape.

posts.name: WeDecide
posts.tagline: Group trip decision tool
posts.description: WeDecide is a tool for friends to collaboratively plan trips. The product collects accommodation links, dates, and budget proposals into one shared space where everyone can vote. Organizers can see group consensus and pending votes to finalize a plan that gets the trip booked.

posts.name: Oxslate: Someone Remembers
posts.tagline: Someone keeps the list. You just get the reminder.
posts.description: Other household apps are symmetric: two people log chores and get measured. OxSlate is lopsided on purpose. One person keeps the admin (bills, renewals, forms). The other gets one calm reminder at a time with a Done button, and needs no account, no email, no list. They can pause, decline, hand an item back or disconnect, and the sender can't override it. No streaks, scores or read receipts; the data model can't hold them. Hold to talk for 30 seconds and get separate, dated reminders.

posts.name: onsystem
posts.tagline: Keep coding agents on your design system
posts.description: onsystem checks agent-written React against your real components and tokens: palette colors, native elements and APIs your design system lacks, at every edit and pull request, with the fix. MCP server, Claude Code plugin, ESLint plugin and GitHub Action. MIT.

posts.name: Brand Identity API
posts.tagline: Turn any website into a brand kit your AI can use
posts.description: Give it a domain and it hands back the company's brand: logos for light and dark (SVG first), HEX colors by role, and the fonts the site really loads. Go deeper for 21 sections: the design as a DESIGN.md, the voice as a brand.md, plus pricing, products, competitors, open roles, contacts and investors. Even its email security. Anything we read off a page comes with the exact quote and its URL. No quote, no fact. Call it over REST or MCP. 50 lookups free, then $39 for 10k a month.

posts.name: Modes Explorer
posts.tagline: Hear modal colors and explore the harmony behind them
posts.description: Connect modes to actual listening and writing. Explore how a mode relates to its parent scale, see its intervals and chord options, and use playback to hear the character behind the theory. Build modal progressions when you want a different harmonic color. Modes Explorer was created with Jacob Lizzio from Signals Music Studio. The full app is free in your browser, with optional Ad-Free access to remove cross-app recommendations.

posts.name: WaterfallHikes.com
posts.tagline: Waterfall hikes with live stream flow and LiDAR terrain
posts.description: Explore waterfall hikes across the US and Canada with live stream-gauge data, 7-day flow outlooks, trail guides, 3D terrain, and alerts when nearby waterfalls are running high.

posts.name: Beat Chuck
posts.tagline: Free sports predictions with friends and leaderboards
posts.description: Beat Chuck offers free sports prediction challenges for fans. Make your picks, follow public leaderboards, and compete with friends in private groups. A sports newsroom publishes coverage alongside the games. Contact: chuck@beatchuck.com.

posts.name: Petal
posts.tagline: Your personal PDF editor. Just type what you need.
posts.description: Petal lets you edit PDFs by describing what you want: merge, split, convert, watermark, pull text from scans. Your files are private to you and deleted automatically within 1-2 days. Free: 5 edits a day, 25 MB. Pro: $2/month for 50 edits a day and 100 MB files.

posts.name: FoldFocus
posts.tagline: The focus timer you start by closing your phone
posts.description: FoldFocus is a focus timer you start by closing your phone: fold an iPhone Duo shut, or turn any iPhone face down. While it stays closed, a pixel building rises in your city. Open it early and you have 10 seconds before it falls. No account, no app blocking.

posts.name: FoldFocus
posts.tagline: The focus timer you start by closing your phone
posts.description: FoldFocus is a focus timer you start by closing your phone: fold an iPhone Duo shut, or turn any iPhone face down. While it stays closed, a pixel building rises in your city. Open it early and you have 10 seconds before it falls. No account, no app blocking.

posts.name: DawnDuo
posts.tagline: Sunrise alarm. Designed for iPhone Duo.
posts.description: Turn your iPhone or iPad display into a 10–45 minute sunrise. On iPhone Duo, keep it half open beside the bed and close it while the alarm rings to snooze for nine minutes. One purchase, seven languages, no subscription, account or tracking. The light needs the app open with the display unlocked; the system alarm works independently with permission.

posts.name: Clinch
posts.tagline: Recover Shopify sales. Know if your offers really work.
posts.description: Clinch shows a one-time offer when a shopper is about to leave your Shopify store, on the product they were viewing. Each code is unique and single-use, limiting coupon sharing, and no email is required. Unlike typical exit-intent apps, Clinch uses a randomized holdout group to measure whether offers actually increase conversions instead of taking credit for sales that would happen anyway. A margin floor caps discounts, and every attributed sale links to a real Shopify order.

posts.description: Alpha turns raw phone clips into a finished Instagram reel. Pick a trending template, add any clips, and ALPHA Video AI cuts them on the beat, picks the best moments and adds slow-mo, VFX, text and sound. Ready in minutes — free in your browser and on Android.

posts.name: agent-usage-guard
posts.tagline: Stop Claude Code from spending your usage window in minutes
posts.description: A Claude Code mod that holds runaway agent spend before it happens: it reads your plan's live 5-hour and weekly usage, then asks before subagent fan-out, heavy-context prompts and retry loops - and refuses when nobody can answer. Local and privacy-minimal (no network, no processes, never stores prompt text), fails open, and /agent-guard report shows what it did. MIT, one plugin install command.

posts.name: App icon Maker, Logo Generator
posts.tagline: Generate icon & Logo with AI
posts.description: Design a logo, app icon, poster or business card in minutes, no design skills needed. Logo Maker gives you beautiful, ready-made templates and a simple editor that puts every detail at your fingertips. Start from a template or a blank canvas, tap to change anything, and export a high-resolution image you can use anywhere.

posts.name: Rewire
posts.tagline: Lock in your routine: habits, focus and goals in one app
posts.description: Rewire puts your whole routine in one place: habits, focus sessions, long-term goals, to-dos, a food log and reminders that arrive as real notifications, even when the app is closed. It is built on habit research. Streaks survive a single missed day, every habit has a two-minute version for low-energy days, and progress follows the roughly 66 days it takes for a habit to feel automatic. Free, no ads, on web and Android.

posts.name: Codeco.tech
posts.tagline: Your Shop, Already Built All Unique. Human-Designed. Own One
posts.description: 30 individually Designed Human-Built Apps—NOT AI templates. Ex Vodafone R&D Engineer with 25 years in Making Full Stack APPS with Corporate Security. Get A complete e-commerce business, already built and ready to customise. Get your storefront, product catalogue, shopping cart, Stripe checkout, Google sign-in and admin tools. Connect three accounts - your database, Google sign-in and Stripe — and follow our step-by-step Unstuck Videos to get set up. Own the code, Pay Once, and get setup support.

posts.name: Wizstar Video Translation
posts.tagline: Translate videos with real emotion and perfect lip sync
posts.description: Wizstar recognizes 99 source languages and translates videos into 75 target languages with expressive, native-sounding dubbing, voice cloning and precise lip sync even for plosives, closed-mouth sounds, long vowels and sighs. It supports multiple speakers, side profiles, partially obscured faces and complex movements including people moving in and out of frame. Localize videos for global marketing, cross-border e-commerce, education, short dramas, and social media.

posts.name: Billion Ballots

posts.description: Explore every election since Indian independence on interactive maps. Open any seat's profile, track swing, build your own forecast, find your constituency, and simulate the Delimitation Bill 2026. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Kairos
posts.tagline: Team collaboration, built for the terminal.
posts.description: Your terminal. Your team. Zero context switching. Kairos brings real-time collaboration straight to your terminal. Create rooms, chat, share files, and monitor system resources all without juggling heavyweight GUI apps. Built with Bun, TypeScript, WebSockets, and Prisma, Kairos is on a mission to make developer workflows lighter, faster, and terminal-native. Less switching. Less overhead. More building.

posts.name: SocialSpider AI
posts.tagline: Create, schedule, and grow social content with AI
posts.description: SocialSpider AI is an agentic AI platform that grows your social media presence AND your AI visibility. Autonomous agents create on-brand content and engineer it to be cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and Perplexity. Two growth engines, one AI team.

posts.name: Battery Orbit
posts.tagline: app that manages your MacBook's charging
posts.description: Battery Orbit keeps a plugged-in MacBook between limits you choose (20–90% by default): it charges to the top, runs on battery to the bottom with the cable still in, and repeats. Three modes (Custom Orbit, Natural Flow, Desk Hold), Charge to 100% once for travel days, calibration you start yourself to keep the % honest, and Insights showing time in range day by day. Pause gives normal charging back instantly. One-time price, no account, no subscription.
